findings.description: A Content-Type parameter with no '=' (e.g. 'text/html; charset') now yields the boolean True as its value, so get_encoding_from_headers calls .strip() on a bool and raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response whose Content-Type header is 'text/html; charset' with no value. The new code stores params['charset'] = True instead of skipping the token, so the 'charset' in params check passes and params['charset'].strip(...) fails on a bool. Impact: get_encoding_from_headers raises instead of falling back to the default encoding, which surfaces to the user as a crash on a malformed but previously tolerated header.
